citations.assessment: The gold passage calls Petriki the brother of Rabbi Derosai. The checked wording names Rabbi Ivo Abba together; a separate reporting link from Rabbi is not explicit.
Rabbi Petriki, brother of Rabbi Derosah, quotes Rabbi Abba son of Rabbi Buna.
The parallel is in chapter 4 halakhah 4 in the checked edition. It uses Rabbi Patroki, Derosa, and Ba bar Bina.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015
